units.source_text: 接着讲下去之前，得先跟他们解释下河童到底是什么。

en.t: Before going on with the story, I first had to explain to them exactly what kappa are.

units.source_text: 河童到底是不是真实存在的，至今还尚未有定论。

en.t: Whether kappa really exist has still not been settled even today.

units.source_text: 但是对我来说，我已经跟它们一起住过，当然确定它们是存在的了。

en.t: But as for me, since I had already lived among them, I was of course certain that they existed.

units.source_text: 那么河童究竟是种什么动物呢？

en.t: Then what sort of creature is a kappa after all?

units.source_text: 它们脑袋上长着短毛，手脚上有蹼，就跟《河童考略》记载的差不多。

en.t: They have short hair growing on their heads and webbing on their hands and feet, much as recorded in A Brief Study of Kappa.

units.source_text: 身高约莫一米左右的样子。

en.t: They stand about one meter tall.

units.source_text: 据查喀医生描述，一般体重在三十磅的样子，当然偶尔也会有五十几磅的超大河童。

en.t: According to Doctor Chaka, they generally weigh around thirty pounds, though of course there are occasionally enormous kappa of over fifty pounds.

units.source_text: 头顶上有一个凹进去的椭圆的一块，年龄越大就会变得越来越硬。

en.t: On the top of the head is a sunken oval patch, which grows harder and harder with age.

units.source_text: 老年的巴咯头顶上的凹处跟年轻的查喀医生的凹处完全不一样。

en.t: The hollow on old Bago's head was completely different from the one on young Doctor Chaka's.

units.source_text: 河童的皮肤是最为奇怪的。

en.t: The strangest thing about kappa is their skin.

units.source_text: 它们跟人类不同，

en.t: Unlike humans,

units.source_text: 没有固定的肤色，

en.t: they have no fixed skin color,

units.source_text: 它们的肤色会随着环境的变化而变化——

en.t: and their skin color changes with their surroundings.

units.source_text: 举个例子来说，

en.t: For example,

units.source_text: 在草丛里，会变成草绿色；

en.t: in the grass, it turns grass green;

units.source_text: 在岩石上，就变成岩石那种灰呼呼的颜色了。

en.t: on rocks, it turns that dull gray color of stone.

units.source_text: 就跟变色龙差不多。

en.t: It is much like a chameleon.

units.source_text: 也许在某种皮肤组织方面，河童和变色龙有相似的地方吧。

en.t: Perhaps kappa and chameleons are similar in some aspect of their skin tissue.

units.source_text: 关于它们皮肤这件事，我记得民俗民俗学上有过记载，

en.t: As for their skin, I remember seeing it recorded in folklore studies,

units.source_text: 西国河童的皮肤是绿色的，东北河童的肤色是红色的。

en.t: that kappa in the western provinces have green skin, while kappa in the northeast have red skin.

units.source_text: 我还想起来，我当时追赶巴咯的时候，他从我眼前失踪了那一次。

en.t: I also remembered the time when I was chasing Bago and he vanished right before my eyes.

units.source_text: 此外，我估计河童的皮下脂肪应该非常厚，

en.t: Besides that, I suppose kappa must have very thick subcutaneous fat,

units.source_text: 因为这个位于地下的河童国气温挺低（平均在华氏五十度左右），

en.t: because the temperature in this underground kappa country is quite low, averaging around fifty degrees Fahrenheit,

units.source_text: 但是它们却都不穿衣服。

en.t: and yet none of them wear clothes.

units.source_text: 当然也没必要说，每只河童都戴眼镜，携带纸烟盒和钱包之类的东西，

en.t: Of course, it goes without saying that every kappa wears glasses and carries things like cigarette cases and wallets,

units.source_text: 河童的腹部有一个跟袋鼠类似的袋子，所有东西都扔在里面很是方便。

en.t: for a kappa has a pouch on its belly like a kangaroo's, making it very convenient to toss everything inside.

units.source_text: 让我觉得好笑的是，它们连腰身也不遮挡起来。

en.t: What I found amusing was that they did not even cover their waists.

units.source_text: 有一次，我忍不住问巴咯为什么会这样。

en.t: Once, I could not help asking Bago why that was so.

units.source_text: 巴咯听完哈哈大笑，回复我说：“我觉得你遮挡起来更加好笑呢。”

en.t: After hearing me out, Bago burst into laughter and replied, "I think it is even funnier that you cover yourself."
